title: Cumulative residual-directed hidden neuron construction via direct numerical weight edits

parent.head: c882f1dc951f20d1dfcc48952fd2d0fd84f28389
parent.state: WSP68 frozen NEGATIVE; 144/768 confident correct, 8/298 unseen correct, 24 wrong, 28/384 composites, 71.13% retention; online fixed readout edits matched separately converged ridge exactly; focused and G29 PASS two OS, full inherited still in progress.

question: Does residual-guided construction and persistent editing of real ReLU hidden neurons create more useful generalization and retention than identically sized random hidden neurons, without source-aligned symbolic causal-rule programming?

source.family: Four parity XOR, four three-way conjunction and four mixed parity/negated conjunction/coupled action-effect worlds. Newly salted and permuted from WSP69 source; partly same mechanism families as WSP68, not natural out-of-distribution transfer.
source.train: 96 charged physically continuous no-reset randomized actions per world from all-zero sensor state, one COMMON public ledger for all arms, Stage A 48 and Stage B +48. No arbitrary source queries, hidden roles, or labels.
source.audit: 12×16 states×4 actions=768 full evaluator-only physical outcomes after both phases, split genuinely observed vs unseen; 32 two-action compositions/world=384 evaluator-only tasks.

candidate.representation: 8 binary inputs (4 sensors + 4 public action one-hots), frozen independent 32 ReLU neuron bank seeded 68182026, plus raw 8 skip and bias. Append 12 stage-A and 12 stage-B real adaptive ReLU neurons, with weights derived from actual input vector of residual-heavy public training observations. Each new neuron h(x)=ReLU(1-0.5 Hamming(x,c)) using source-blind prototype c and no output labels embedded. Hidden weights therefore constructed/edited from experience; NOT a source-specific causal rule compiler or an automatically discovered universal representation grammar.
candidate.selection: At each milestone, fit source-blind ridge (λ=0.5) readout to available charged observations with current bank (without new neurons). Rank each unique observed public state/action by mean squared four-sensor residual of its charged outcomes, descending with canonical state/action tie-breaking; append up to 12 largest residual unselected public exemplars. First 12 after 48 charges, another 12 after 96. No heldout or source-physics access. No selection tuning or validation-on-test.
candidate.weight_updates: After appending neurons, replay ONLY the actual charged public ledger into a 4-output recursive ridge least-squares (initial readout zero, inverse-covariance 2I, rank-one Sherman Morrison). Resulting readout and hidden neuron weight/bias arrays are actual numerical neural parameters, and update via direct weight programming, not gradients.
candidate.confidence: Per bit margin abs(raw−0.5) >=0.27 and posterior feature leverage <=2.0 for confident full-vector prediction, using same thresholds as WSP68. Forced results reported. All models see identical cutoff; no tuning.
candidate.retention: Matrix-only cold restore and tamper rejection in both phases; stage-A correct confident physical outcomes must remain correct/confident after Stage B. Saved model snapshot excludes charged experience/source and inferred table.

controls: Width-matched random exemplar hidden neuron bank (12 after 48, 12 after 96), selected uniformly without outcome/residual access from SAME observed state/action contexts, same initial random ReLU bank and same readout RLS and confidence thresholds; per-world independent fixed seed.
Source-independent fixed 32-ReLU feature bank + skips and direct ridge readout at 48/96, exactly WSP68 algorithm on same WSP69 ledger.
Same history exact state/action lookup, abstain on unknown; evaluator-only physical correctness.

Independently trained fully optimized end-to-end 8→32 ReLU→4 sigmoid neural MLP with Adam from 3 deterministic initializations, up to 6000 optimization updates per restart, 96 charged public training examples, train-side target >=95% exact on charged contexts. If unconverged, mark INCOMPLETE, do not claim direct superiority; report best training-side model and full forced/confident accuracy.
Independent fully fitted depth-4 binary decision tree over the same charged contexts; report full confident error counts, and two-action consequences.
Erased readout and zero hidden-feature control to demonstrate construction makes a behavioral difference.
primary: SELFTEST_SIGNAL if and only if (A) candidate >=35 confidently correct genuinely UNOBSERVED state/action consequences, (B) candidate >=210 confident correct of all 768 and at least 30 more than exact memory, (C) candidate exceeds width-matched random-neuron model on unseen correct by >=15 and all-domain confident correct by >=25 without making >5 additional confident errors, (D) <=20 confident incorrect physical predictions, (E) >=80/384 correct two-action compositions with both steps confident, (F) >=85% of Stage-A previously confident/correct contexts remain correct and confident at Stage B, (G) >=10/12 worlds have actual new hidden neuron weights and readout changes, 12/12 cold restores/tamper controls, and (H) total direct training plus inference CPU <=3x width-matched random neuron baseline with identical 96 physical actions. Else SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE. Full conventional MLP convergence is mandatory before claiming neural superiority, but its failure alone does not change the mechanism SELFTEST classification.
secondary: Source/charged ledger and heldout composition SHA256; counts and retention by physics family and genuinely unseen state-action split
Converged end-to-end trained neural MLP 3 initializations with 6000 max per restart: training-side convergence/seed, forced and high-confidence heldout; zero gradients for direct writer
Random-neuron same-width readout cost and performance, direct append/replay CPU and wall, source/feature weight snapshot bytes and params
Exact observation memory, independent decision tree, erased neural readout ablation
No symbolic causal predicate candidate enumerator at all in candidate and control
Whole learner cost including residual ranking/replay, neural matrix editing and heldout inference; no free evaluation observations consumed as training
limits: Prototype ReLU neuron location is built from individual experienced inputs; apparent gain can be local interpolation or memorization. Explicit unseen audit and random-center/memory controls must be disclosed.
Prewired 8-bit binary action/state encoding, prototype-neuron functional shape, and source-specific small synthetic environment remain major priors; does not discover general cognitive primitives.
Conventional end-to-end MLP must actually meet training convergence; otherwise it is an incomplete baseline, not evidence of direct editing superiority.
A failed confidence/retention criterion is an immutable scientific negative. No post-result cutoff/architecture/source/seed tuning.
No language, variable-dimensional senses, hidden-state POMDP, general intelligence, or independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
stop: Freeze prospectively before any experiment source/learner/results and keep unchanged after outcomes.
Engineering evidence requires exact source SHA, focused Linux+Windows, G29 source atlas, inherited full two-platform regression; no duplicate live regressions.
All experiments SELFTEST, do not use protected DEV/PRIMARY for new first-use.
Remain draft/unmerged; no official owner-loop/CKB authority expansion.
